answer: Each identity enrolls a motor-signature: days of its operator's keystroke dwell times, flight intervals, and pressure jitter, hashed into a template — an opal's play-of-color, impossible to duplicate. Every epoch the agent streams a fresh sample bound to that epoch's nonce, checked within a tolerance terrace; replays die on the nonce. A farm cannot clone one signature across puppets: identical templates collapse into one vote, like a tide erasing footprints to a single track. N puppets need N real typists on call each epoch — linear wages — while an honest user enrolls once.
